index.html: We strive to teach children how to strengthen their bodies and build skills that are used in nearly every sport.  We make learning and fitness fun.
Enroll at any point in the month and your fees are prorated!

Stoughton Gymnastics provides full gymnastics programming that includes instruction on the Bars, Beam, Floor and Vault. Participants will rotate through the gymnastic events and utilize the tumble track (long trampoline) to work on skill development, coordination and have FUN.
Stoughton Gymnastics is located in beautiful Downtown Stoughton at 201 W. Main Street.
Fees vary based on class length, from $69.50/mo
USAG and AAU levels include Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond. Competitive team members practice 2 x per week, ranging from 75-120 minutes per class.
To view the CLASS SCHEDULE, click "Schedule and Enrollment" button below.

class-schedule.html: All enrollments are processed in the PARENT PORTAL. Click on "Schedule and Enrollment" on the homepage and our system will let you search for classes based on your child's age and other options you may choose as a filter.
All classes are billed monthly. The 1st month's tuition is due upon enrolling. Enrollment is continuous but you may withdraw at any point pending notification outlined in our policies section.
We prorate the first month’s tuition if starting mid-month.
50% off tuition for a 2nd+ class for the same child.
10% off tuition for 2nd child. 50% off tuition for 3rd+ child.

classes-offered.html: Classes are 30 minutes in length, Parent participation is required in the 2-3 yr old classes. Classes are held in the Circus Pre-School room, with 4-5 students per class.
Classes are fully independent, 40-45 minutes in length held in the main gym. Students will use regulation gymnastics equipment.
Classes are 45-60 minutes in length, depending on age and skill attainment

XCEL Competitive Gymnastics is offered. Current levels include: Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. XCEL gymnasts practice 2 days per week with practice times ranging from 75-120 minutes depending on XCEL level.
This is a fast-moving class that keeps kids moving by working on balance & strength in FUN activities. Circuits to include: trampoline, obstacle courses, bars, and friendly physical challenges.
(ADD a second class day for 50% off)
team-gymnastics.html: The Xcel program allows gymnasts to start competing with beginner/intermediate skills in entry levels, such as Copper and Bronze.

There are 6 levels of Xcel: Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond. We currently compete in all 6 levels and also offer a Recreational Team. Commitments range from 1-2 hours a week for entry levels/part-year and 4-6 hours a week/year-round for upper levels.
